note: Rewritten from the species description in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India: Isoptera, entry 156; originally in English; all three castes are present, nymphs are lacking; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and the description of the wing membrane microsculpture have been deleted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Body small. Alate head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly parallel, V-shaped suture absent, compound eyes and ocelli both small, antennae 13–14-segmented; soldier head capsule subrectangular, fontanelle appearing as a white spot, mandibles coarsely serrate with the apex not strongly hooked, postmentum rod-shaped with the waist behind the middle; worker head capsule subquadrate, anterior margin of the pronotum without a notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale brown to dark brown; antennae and labrum pale brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; body pale yellow. Head sparsely pilose, body more densely pilose. Body length 3.8–4.30 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel (to mandibular base 1.12–1.29 mm, maximum width 0.75–0.80 mm). Fontanelle minute, circular, appearing as a white spot, situated in the anterior third of the head capsule. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Labrum nearly parallel from the sides to the middle, narrowing anteriorly into a slightly pointed apex (length 0.18–0.20 mm, width 0.20–0.22 mm). Mandibles coarsely serrate, length 0.70–0.72 mm, about two-thirds the head capsule length (left mandible length/head length ratio 0.59–0.62). Postmentum rod-shaped, waist behind the middle (length 0.65–0.70 mm, maximum width 0.28–0.29 mm, waist width 0.16–0.18 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a distinct notch; posterior margin slightly concave; length 0.22–0.25 mm, width 0.48–0.50 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, the rest of the body pale yellow. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 4.1–4.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (to mandibular base 0.82–0.87 mm, maximum width 0.77–0.80 mm). Frontal plate pale, indistinct, appearing as a white spot. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, pilose, length about half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.17–0.20 mm, width 0.42–0.45 mm); anterior margin without a notch, posterior margin slightly concave.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and pronotum chocolate brown; antennae dark brown; postclypeus as dark as the head capsule; legs yellowish brown; abdomen slightly paler than the head capsule. Head moderately pilose, body densely pilose. Body length with wings 5.8–7.0 mm, without wings 3.8–4.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly parallel (to the apex of the labrum 0.93–1.00 mm, to the mandibular base 0.65–0.75 mm, maximum width including the compound eyes 0.70–0.78 mm); V-shaped suture absent. Fontanelle minute, visible under strong light. Compound eyes small, subcircular, about one quarter of their diameter from the lower margin of the head (major diameter 0.20–0.23 mm, minor diameter 0.18–0.20 mm). Ocelli small, oval (major diameter 0.07–0.08 mm, minor diameter 0.05–0.06 mm), separated from the compound eye by their short diameter (0.05 mm). Antennae 13–14-segmented; with 13 segments, segment 2 twice as long as segment 3 and segments 4 and 5 about equal; with 14 segments, segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 ring-like and shortest, segment 4 shorter than segment 5. Postclypeus moderately convex, length about equal to half its width. Pronotum subtrapezoidal (length 0.30–0.38 mm, width 0.53–0.58 mm); anterior margin slightly convex, without a median notch; posterior margin with a distinct notch. Wings smoky brown; forewing length 4.7–5.4 mm, hindwing length 4.5–5.2 mm.
